title: Antique Brass Triple Tier Glass Shelf, 16 X 5 Inch, Wall-Mounted, Solid Brass Hardware, Glass Shelves Collection, Allied Brass
description:

This wall-mounted glass shelf (also called a bathroom shelf or wall shelf) adds three tiers for organized, easy-to-reach storage in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Keep the installation looking clean with concealed screw mounting hardware

This wall-mounted glass shelf (also called a bathroom shelf or wall shelf) adds three tiers for organized, easy-to-reach storage in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Keep the installation looking clean with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Use it as a floating shelf style organizer above a vanity or in a compact bath
- Coordinate with other transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories in the Glass Shelves collection, with multiple designer finish options available

Specs & Installation:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 inch)
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging
- Assembly required: false
- Included items: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 inch
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
